themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 151 THIS WEEK—a 452% jump from the 27.4 weekly average—suggesting rapid deterioration of road surfaces across Sunnyside/Woodside, with concurrent spikes in damaged trees (9 complaints vs. 1.8 avg) and missing street signs (5 vs. 1.2 avg) pointing to broader public realm neglect.
evidence: 151 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 27.4 weekly average (452% spike, z-score 12.24)
9 damaged tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.8 weekly average (414% spike, z-score 7.49)
5 missing street sign complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average (300% spike, z-score 4.52)
reporting_angles: Ground-truth reporting: photograph affected streets and intersections; interview residents about safety hazards (potholes, trip risks)
City accountability: when was last street resurfacing cycle in this district? Is this a budget or maintenance scheduling issue?

themes_detail.label: Encampment Surge
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 22 THIS WEEK—a 376% spike from the 4.6 weekly baseline—marking a sharp escalation in visible homelessness or informal settlements across the district, coinciding with broader street condition deterioration.
evidence: 22 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.6 weekly average (376% spike, z-score 4.61)
Spike emerged abruptly with no prior warning in 8-week baseline data
Concurrent with street condition and infrastructure complaints, suggesting possible displacement or migration
reporting_angles: On-the-ground investigation: where are encampments concentrated? Are residents reporting safety concerns (sanitation, needles, crime)?
Policy context: is this a result of shelter closures, weather patterns, or displacement from adjacent areas? Speak to local nonprofits and outreach teams.

themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Epidemic
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints exploded to 5 LAST WEEK—a 3900% spike from the near-zero 0.1 weekly baseline—indicating a sudden onset of graffiti, unauthorized signage, or poster campaigns across the district.
evidence: 5 illegal posting complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (3900% spike, z-score 14.74)
No prior sustained pattern; essentially unprecedented in the 8-week baseline
Aligns with street sweeping spike (6 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 avg, z-score 13.28), suggesting coordinated debris/cleanliness issue
reporting_angles: Visual survey: photograph affected blocks and poles; identify whether posters are political, commercial, or gang-related
Timeline: did a specific event (election, concert, protest) trigger this, or is it organized tagging?

themes_detail.label: Building Code/Use Violations
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints surged to 12 THIS WEEK—a 380% spike from the 2.5 weekly average—suggesting rapid onset of code violations, illegal occupancy, or unpermitted alterations across the district; 565 DOB permits filed in 90 days show active construction environment.
evidence: 12 building/use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.5 weekly average (380% spike, z-score 5.27)
565 total DOB permits filed in last 90 days (385 alterations, 97 new buildings), indicating active renovation/development activity
Concurrent with unsanitary animal/property complaints (3 last week vs. 0.2 avg), suggesting code enforcement may be overwhelmed
reporting_angles: Investigation: which blocks or building types are generating violations? Are landlords converting to short-term rentals, subdividing illegally, or ignoring maintenance?
DOB capacity: is the permit surge outpacing inspection capacity? Interview building department and compare complaint-to-violation closure rates.

themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions / Animal Issues
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary animal/private property complaints jumped to 3 LAST WEEK—a 1100% spike from the 0.2 weekly baseline—paired with broader sanitation concerns (street sweeping up 2300%), indicating potential pest, waste, or animal control deterioration.
evidence: 3 unsanitary animal/private property complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
6 street sweeping complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (2300% spike, z-score 13.28)
General unsanitary condition complaints remain elevated overall (260 in 90 days), suggesting chronic underlying issue
reporting_angles: Environmental health: interview DOHMH and Sanitation; are there specific blocks with rat, raccoon, or feral cat problems? Any food vendor or commercial waste violations?
Systemic: is street sweeping schedule adequate for district density? When was last full sanitation audit?
